learning_outcomes.text: Uses technical drawing tools and equipment and has knowledge of technical drawing.
Knows how to create views and can draw views
Understands and can apply dimensioning and dimensioning principles
Knows how to take cross-sections and can create drawings
Surface roughness and tolerances can be shown in a technical drawing
Draws manufacturing drawings in accordance with general technical drawing rules

syllabus_topics: Organization of design and construction office, introduction of hardware and tools. Line types, texts and numbers.
Orthographic view extraction techniques. Auxiliary view extraction techniques and applications.
Orthographic view extraction techniques. Auxiliary view extraction techniques and applications.
Belts and pulleys. Bearings and cams. Gears.
Part drawings obtained from assembly drawings
bibliography: Temel Teknik Resim, İ. Zeki Şen, Nail Özçilingir, İstanbul, 2002
MAKİNE RESMİ, İ. Z. ŞEN, N. ÖZÇİLİNGİR, DE-HA yayımcılık, 2005.
T. Resim-I ve T.Resim-II uygulama yaprakları
